remaining: At 9b2874ba: one complete 357-case pass, then a matching 350-pass/7-failure repeat. Both retain all 258 behavioral obligations and 40 device profiles; no identities missing.

The second repeat fails lucide-3019 and six early desktop profile idle gates after a 702-event storm. All text-history variants, all six stability cycles and all 15 popout drop variants pass in both complete attempts.

At traced checkpoint 84a30be0 the 172-desktop-plus-core sequence captures 16879 notifications. Its sustained loop first appears during native:lifecycle-new-popout-survivor; one earlier popout Markdown notification is transient. No JavaScript exceptions; all functional cases execute, but strict parent idle/cleanup-idle gates fail.

Isolated Lucide and lifecycle controls pass with zero events. Empty-popout observer controls with both community runtimes unloaded also pass. These clean controls do not exonerate the ordered drawing sequence or justify a production patch.

Next action: isolate the state retained between the desktop workflows and fresh-popout teardown, then propose a minimal production fix for approval only if evidence supports it. Do not rerun full acceptance without new evidence. Two fresh complete matching-build passes remain required after any implementation change.
